long_biography.plain_text:
Rasmussen began as a marine engineer before establishing Vestland Rederi in Haugesund in 1997. The business later continued in Poland as Vestland Marine, an integrated manager of dry-cargo ships and chemical and product tankers. At its height it managed as many as 14 vessels, while keeping operations, crewing and some chartering in house.

Rasmussen applied the same discipline to historic passenger ships. Through Vestland Classic, he became the driving force behind returning a protected former coastal liner to service, first on expedition voyages and later on Northern European routes. He has also acquired and maintained other older working ships. The pattern is consistent across his career: hands-on ship management, selective ownership and the commercial reuse of vessels with cultural value.
